translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: 1 TESALONICA
book.title: Dos Unnon Sulat ni Pablo Atag to mgo Toho TESALONICA

content: Dos Kodpanoypanoy atag to Kodlivod tod Longaggon
Na mgo suwod, moka-atag to kouhayyoy woy ko kannu ini od kotomanan, konnad ko-ilangan nod sosulat koy pa koniyu.
Oyyos nokosaddoo kowd man no iddos allow to kodlivod tod Longaggon, tigkow od inguma iling to tokawon diyot bulli.

Od pon-ikahi kos mgo minuvu no, “Waa samuk to ko-ubpa ta woy moriyu ki to kororattan.” Piru tigkow od inguma kandan kos kororattan iling to ba-ay nod sokalan. Woy iddon timpu, waa en minuvu nod poko-olihu to silut to Monama.
Piru sikiyu mgo suwod, waa kowd diyot mosukirom, de-en otid inguma ron iddon allow no iling to tigkow no kod-inguma to tokawon, konna kow od kotigkawan.
Su langun dow, mgo minuvu ron man to ko-owangan woy allow. Waa kid diyon to mosukirom woy bulli.
De-en konna ki od tintinuhon to keton kopomakoy iling to duma, ko konna, ko-ilangan no nopanoy ki woy duwon kodtohoo ta to keton ko-ugolingun.
Oyyos bulli kos timpu to kodtinuhon to mgo minuvu, woy dos polohubug, bulli rad en mandad kos timpu nod kohubug.

Piru siketa, su riyon kid man to ko-owangan, ko-ilangan no od toholan ta kos keton ko-ugolingun. Ko-ilangan nod iling ki to sokkad no sundau no od sukub to putow no umpak, no idda en so keton kopomakoy woy kodginawa, woy id sukub ta mandad kos putow no somboriru, no idda en so mosalig no ko-immanan ta nod kotobbus ki.
Oyyos waa ki id aam to Monama amoy'd silutan, ko konna, amoy od kotobbus ukit tod Longaggon ta no si Disas Krays.
Id patoy sikandin atag keta, su amoy ahad id patoy kid o no-uyag poron diyot kodlivod din, od poko-ubpa ki duma kandin.
De-en ponayun kow po-inniyatoy woy potovangoy no od mosalig kos koniyun kopomakoy, iling taddot id puungan dow ko-ungkay.
Kotompusan no mgo Pomandu woy Kodpongumusta
Na mgo suwod, od buyuwon doy koniyu, no od rispituwan dow iddos id oiluggat atag koniyu. Id aam sikandan nod ponguu koniyu amoy od pomandu moka-atag to kopomakoy row tod Longaggon.
De-en ginowanni row woy rispitu-i row sikandan pomon taddot id puungan dan atag koniyu. Oubpa kow no moppiya kos koroniyan diyon to ipat sokkad.

Mgo suwod, od loglohottan doy sikiyu, no suhuwa row iddos mgo poggulon no ko-ilangan nod puung sikandan. Inniyata row iddos mgo taawon, woy tovangi row iddos mgo moomet diyon to kopomakoy. Woy poowetta row kos posinsya row riyot langun no minuvu.
Noonokkali row no waa sokkad koniyu nod puung to morat diyot id puung to morat koniyu, ko konna, noonokkali row inaayun no od puung to moppiya riyon tod pompomakoy woy riyot langun no minuvu.
Kahaa kow inaayun,
woy inaayun kow dasaa.
Diyot ahad ondan no kotomanan, posolamat kow inaayun, oyya su ini en kos id kopi-it Monama taddot langun no nosokkad diyot ki Disas Krays.
Yo row boovahi kos Uhis no Ispiritu,
woy yo row poddisokki to koru-anon iddos osengan taddot minuvu no duwon id poposaddoo to Monama kandin.
Oonongnga row pa iddos langun no nonaw ko mooggot bo no id pomon to Monama. Iyon dow ikula iddos moppiya,
woy poriyu kow to ahad ondan no kororattan.

Muopa no iddos Monama no id boggoy to kosunayan, od tavang koniyu amoy'd molinis kow riyot kod-ontong din. Muopa no iddos tivuk no ispiritu row, gimukud woy lawa, waa id pokosawoy riyon to kodlivod tod Longaggon ta no si Disas Krays.
Dos Monama no id aam koniyu, od kosolihan woy od puungan din en ini.
Mgo suwod, dasaa kow atag konami.
Po-uma row kos kodpongumusta roy riyot langun no suwod ta riyot kopomakoy duma to kodginawa.
Ukit to kotungud no id boggoy koddi tod Longaggon, od suhuwon ku sikiyu, no bosa-a row inin sulat diyot langun no suwod ta to kopomakoy.
Muopa nod kotanggap dow kos kopiyannoy tod Longaggon ta no si Disas Krays. Na, ka-ay ra en taman.

footnotes.text: Otik diyot Griego no kinohiyan, od pongumusta duma to kod-arok,oyya su ini en kos botasanon to unnon od ponlolivuung nod pompomakoy riyon to kodpokumustay ran.
